hypothesis_clauses.H-D.c1a: act-exclusivity: norms change only through norm-making acts
hypothesis_clauses.H-D.c1b: capability: acts are made by capability holders
hypothesis_clauses.H-D.c2: status: force depends on the status of the making act
hypothesis_clauses.H-B.c1: norms change through acts and in response to work
hypothesis_clauses.H-B.c2: conformance: work conforms to the norms in force
hypothesis_clauses.H-B.c3: feedback: work outcomes feed back into norm changes

premise_kinds.OCC: occasion (trace, work outcome, existence of a text); neutral; necessary; never carries the firing
premise_kinds.TXT: the content of a text as a text; neutral

source_classes.examples: executor work under N; third-party application (ACT-TP, formerly NIF-B); citation (N-ASSERTED, formerly NIF-C)
ruling texts, adoption forms and register rows used as evidence of force

grading_order: 2 UNDETERMINED(reason): a premise is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; a text is missing; an ABS premise is neither NIF-A nor shown complete; or the AF readings disagree
3 condition false: NOT-FIRED if the premise that falsifies it is NIF-A/OCC/TXT; otherwise NON-DISCRIMINATING
4 condition true and every NS/ABS premise from NIF-A: FIRED, or FIRED-CONDITIONAL(SOURCE_STATED_TIME|ACTOR_SET_ID|WEAK_TRACE)
5 condition true with some DX source: DISJUNCTIVE{falsified clause; presupposition set}[CROSS if it contains a clause of the other hypothesis, else SELF/NEUTRAL]; never a falsification
g_sym.symmetry: Each source class has one grade whichever hypothesis it cuts against. No source class is admitted for one hypothesis's falsifiers and not the other's.

repairs.defect: NIF-B is behaviour both hypotheses explain (N1); G-D1 misses act-exclusivity (N2); the fallback is asymmetric (N3).
repairs.correction: Replace G-D1 with G-SYM. NIF-A is the only NIF. NIF-B becomes ACT-TP and NIF-C becomes N-ASSERTED. The graded fallback is removed on both sides.
repairs.sufficiency: A FIRED grade needs NIF-A premises, whose only presupposition (RECORDER_ACCURACY) is a clause of neither hypothesis. Every dual-explainable source is graded DISJUNCTIVE on both sides, which states exactly the disjunction the observation supports.
repairs.prediction_change: Hypothesis-level: none. Operational: every FIRED route needs NIF-A. The realistic outcomes are DISJUNCTIVE, UNDETERMINED or NON-DISCRIMINATING.
repairs.frozen_rule: FR-D1-r2: G-SYM governs every falsifier; N-FORCE only by NIF-A; behaviour establishes acts (ACT-TP, ACT-CONF_TEXT, ACT-CONTRA_TEXT), never N-FORCE or N-CHANGE-NOACT.

repairs.defect: Third-party application (NIF-B) was treated as force and fired P4-HD (O3); only 'expressly voided' downgraded it.
repairs.correction: Delete NIF-B as a force observable; record it as ACT-TP (DX-BEH, presupposing H-B.c2); delete the voided rule; O3 needs NIF-A; CONSEQUENTIAL: FR-D13 item (2) cannot certify independence.
repairs.sufficiency: Using ACT-TP as force is valid only under H-B.c2, so G-SYM gives DISJUNCTIVE{H-D.c2; H-B.c2} CROSS, the exact two-way explanation. No behavioural source reaches FIRED, so silence cannot count as force.
repairs.prediction_change: P4-HD cannot fire on third-party application; the NIF-B route closes for P1, P5, P7 and P8.
repairs.frozen_rule: FR-N1: third-party application = ACT-TP; never N-FORCE; status mediation is independent only via NIF-A (FR-D13 item 0).

repairs.defect: 'No permitting act => not permitted' presupposes H-D.c1a but was used against H-B (P2, C1, O5, ACT-CONTRA).

repairs.sufficiency: Every inference from absence to a state is classed DX-ABS-INF with an explicit presupposition, so it grades DISJUNCTIVE{H-B clause; H-D.c1a}, never FIRED.
repairs.prediction_change: P2/C1, P5-HB, P7-HB and P8-HB cannot fire on absent acts: DISJUNCTIVE CROSS if complete, else UNDETERMINED.
repairs.frozen_rule: FR-N2: a state inferred from the absence of an act is DX-ABS-INF (presupposes H-D.c1a); only NIF-A establishes non-permission, no waiver or no remediation for FIRED.

repairs.defect: The maker's records were a FIRED-CONDITIONAL fallback against H-B, but a maker force assertion was barred against H-D.

repairs.frozen_rule: FR-N3: DX-MAK and DX-ASSERT grade DISJUNCTIVE on every falsifier; FIRED-CONDITIONAL conditions are limited to {SOURCE_STATED_TIME, ACTOR_SET_ID, WEAK_TRACE}.

repairs.defect: 'R-89 already governs' by the sole adopter was frozen as non-adoption, with an unscored sensitivity result.
repairs.correction: The classification is UNKNOWN (AF-N is only a PROPOSAL). Evaluate under AF-N and AF-B (adoption no later than the statement's decision time; 'before t' is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE if recorded after t). Score only an agreeing grade, else UNDETERMINED(AF_READING). An NIF-A status record overrides both readings.
repairs.sufficiency: No scored result depends on the interpretive choice; the defect scenario fires only under AF-N and so becomes UNDETERMINED.
repairs.prediction_change: P4-HD and the P7 rows using AD are likely UNDETERMINED(AF_READING) without NIF-A.
repairs.frozen_rule: FR-N4: for each MAKER_FORCE_ASSERTION by a capability holder, evaluate under AF-N and AF-B; score only the common grade; NIF-A overrides.

repairs.defect: Multibyte hyphens were not matched under LC_ALL=C.
repairs.correction: HY is an explicit alternation of UTF-8 byte strings (ASCII '-', U+2010-U+2015, U+2212, U+FE58, U+FE63, U+FF0D, U+00AD). Typographic-hyphen forms are PRIMARY (PROPOSAL); other variants are VAR.
repairs.sufficiency: Each code point is matched by its exact bytes.

repairs.defect: The merge identity criterion was missing.

DP-P7: 4 any of ACC, G, WV graded U (either AF reading) -> UNDETERMINED(list); AF readings differ -> UNDETERMINED(AF_READING)
8 ACC=F, G=T, WV=F, all A -> FIRED; SOURCE_STATED t_w or WEAK_TRACE -> FIRED-CONDITIONAL(list)
9 otherwise -> DISJUNCTIVE{H-B.c2; presuppositions of the D premises} CROSS
decision_procedures.DP-P7_aggregation: Evaluated per ancestry-minimal ET; the reported grade is the strongest over ETs in the order FIRED > FIRED-CONDITIONAL > DISJUNCTIVE > NOT-FIRED > NON-DISCRIMINATING > UNDETERMINED; each ET's grade is also reported.
DP-P4: 2 NIF-A: R-89 in force at t and not adopted at t -> FIRED (overrides AF)
3 NIF-A: not in force throughout, or adopted before any recorded force -> NOT-FIRED
4 evaluate rows 5-7 under AF-N and AF-B; they differ -> UNDETERMINED(AF_READING)
7 F89 from DX-BEH -> DISJUNCTIVE{H-D.c2; H-B.c2} CROSS; from DX-ASSERT only -> DISJUNCTIVE{H-D.c2; SOURCE_ACCURACY, AF-N} NEUTRAL
V_text: V2 NON-CONFORMS_TEXT: a text recorded before R11 positively blocks WP-4B or states an R-72 precondition unresolved (default scope includes RED), and no text in capture recorded before R11 lifts or narrows it
V3 CONFORMS_TEXT: a text recorded before R11 positively states the proviso met or RED may proceed, and no positive block recorded before R11
DP-C1: 2 NIF-A: not permitted at 16:10- and no waiver -> FIRED-CONDITIONAL(SOURCE_STATED_TIME); NIF-A permitted -> NOT-FIRED
4 V2 and the lifting-text absence shown complete -> DISJUNCTIVE{H-B.c2; H-D.c2, H-D.c1a} CROSS
5 V2 and not complete -> UNDETERMINED(ABSENCE_NOT_EVIDENCED), CAPTURE_PATTERN=NON-CONFORMS_TEXT
decision_procedures.joint: Reported separately; identical DISJUNCTIVE sets are one finding; no procedure's result is a premise of another except P8's inheritance of the P2 grade.

rank0_protocol.environment: git 2.55.0; ordinary working clone (not bare); 7 local branches, 16 remote-tracking refs, 1 tag, 4002 commits; GitHub origin; refs/pull/*, audit logs and push times out of scope; no host access; .github exists and is not inspected
rank0_protocol.capture: the local ref set = every ref printed by git for-each-ref at run time (01_refs.tsv); the walk starts from exactly those tips (tags peeled to commits); HEAD, reflogs and unreachable objects are excluded
rank0_protocol.completeness: NOT_SHOWN; any absence = NOT-EVIDENCED-IN-CAPTURE; ABSENT_IN_COMPLETE_CHANNEL is not a possible output
rank0_protocol.read_only: git for-each-ref, rev-list, rev-parse, log, show, cat-file, merge-base --is-ancestor, config --get, --version; plus sort, awk, cut, sha256sum, find, ls, realpath; GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1; no network; writes only in OUT (outside the repository, new or empty)
rank0_protocol.deterministic: LC_ALL=C, TZ=UTC, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, explicit -c overrides, forced a/ and b/ diff prefixes, sorted sets, no machine paths/URLs/names; byte-identity is claimed only for the same ref set and git version
rank0_protocol.exit_handling: no set -e; ok LABEL RC ALLOWED... records unexpected codes in 00_errors.tsv (-> CAPTURE_ERROR); allowed non-zero: config --get 1, merge-base --is-ancestor 1; script exits 0 completed / 1 unexpected codes / 2 refused to start / 3 CAPTURE_INVALID before the walk

matching.boundaries: left: start of line or a byte not in [0-9A-Za-z]; right: end of line or such a byte
matching.PAT_primary: WP HY 4C HY 1, case-sensitive; typographic-hyphen forms are primary (PROPOSAL)
matching.VAR_variant: [Ww][Pp] SEP? 4 SEP? [Cc] SEP? 1, SEP in HY or {space, _, ., /}; reported, never counted; only-variants -> VARIANT_ONLY and escalate
matching.excluded: WP-4C-10, WP-4C-1a, XWP-4C-1, bare WP-4C, WP-4, section WP-4, WP-4B, identification by technical content
matching.ref_names: PAT/VAR on full ref names; commits reachable from a PAT-named ref and from no non-PAT-named ref (non-merge) are ref-exclusive and enter the hit set
matching.merges: message search includes merges; diff search on merges uses first-parent diffs but counts only own paths (blob differs from every parent, combined diff); tokened merges without own changes are MENTION (M-MERGE); integrated side commits are not promoted

trace_vs_mention.DOC_GOV: ext md|markdown|txt|rst|adoc|org; or segment in {doc(s), governance, ruling(s), decision(s), adr(s), session(s), log(s), notes, plan(s), planning, minutes}; or basename <governance stem>[-_.]*.(yaml|yml|json|csv|tsv|toml); CI definition paths are always NON_DOC
clauses: E1 ET-1: k>=1 and (subject or trailer) and first WP id is WP-4C-1
E2a ET-2: k>=1 and (subject or trailer or body)
E2b ET-2: non-comment added PAT line in a NON_DOC (own) path
E2c ET-2: NON_DOC changed path name matches PAT
E2d ET-2: exclusive to a PAT-named ref and k>=1
else MENTION: M-MERGE | M-COMMENT | M-REMOVAL | M-DOC | M-OTHER

rank0_protocol.timestamps: %at/%ct SOURCE_STATED; ancestry = RECORDING_ORDER; CLOCK_ANOMALY = ct(descendant) < ct(ancestor) over every ancestry pair found; order label per (minimal ET, control/anchor) pair = RECORDING_ORDER | SOURCE_STATED_ORDER (author and committer order agree, not equal, no anomaly) | NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; INFERRED_ORDER only with a written chain; order relative to decision or force always NOT_IDENTIFIABLE
rank0_protocol.earliest_trace: ancestry-minimal ET set (97b) and ET-1 set (97c); 97c empty with 97b non-empty -> WEAK_TRACE
rank0_protocol.window: no lower bound, no date filter; upper bound = capture
rank0_protocol.positive_control: fixed string 'WP-4B RED' in messages; empty -> CAPTURE_INVALID

procedure.freeze: the reviewer extracts rank0-r2.sh verbatim from SPEC-r2.md B.7, records its SHA-256 in FREEZE.txt
worker: W2 record the for-each-ref hash; no fetch/commit/branch/tag change until R2
W3 run into OUT_A and OUT_B back-to-back; diff -r must be empty, else NONDETERMINISM
W4 read the exit code (2: fix OUT only; 3: CAPTURE_INVALID; 1: CAPTURE_ERROR; 0: read 80_status.tsv)
W5 compare ref and commit counts with ENVIRONMENT (7/16/1/4002); a mismatch is REF_DRIFT_VS_ENVIRONMENT, not fatal
W6 write RANK0-REPORT.md (labels, minimal ETs with SOURCE_STATED dates, ref classes, order labels, hashes, canonical key); no hypothesis statements
reviewer: R2 rerun on the same ref set; byte-identity with OUT_A, else NOT_REPRODUCED(REF_DRIFT)
R3 blind-classify from 92/93/94 (all hits if <=60, else the first 60 by hash plus all ETs); a misapplied rule = CLASSIFIER_DEFECT -> DISPUTED -> human (r3); no hand correction
R4 control non-empty; variants not counted; absence wording exact; no git time presented as decision or force
R5 ACCEPT / ACCEPT_WITH_CORRECTIONS (report text only) / REJECT

script: # rank0-r2.sh -- frozen by SPEC-r2 Part B. Do not edit.
# Capture = the local ref set (every ref printed by `git for-each-ref`) of the ordinary working clone.
# Completeness of the capture is NOT shown. Read-only. No network. No host access. No `set -e`.
# Usage (from anywhere inside the working clone):  OUT=/absolute/path/to/new/empty/dir bash rank0-r2.sh
# Exit: 0 completed (read 80_status.tsv) | 1 completed with unexpected exit codes (CAPTURE_ERROR)
#       2 refused to start (nothing searched) | 3 stopped before the walk (CAPTURE_INVALID)
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the repository" ;; esac
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT exists and is not an empty directory"; fi
cd -- "$TOP" || die 2 "cannot cd to the toplevel"
ok() { # ok LABEL RC ALLOWED... : record an unexpected exit code; never aborts
for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" -eq "$a" ] && return 0; done
lst() { # lst LABEL FILE git-args... : git must exit 0; keep non-empty lines, sorted and unique
finish() { # finish EXIT : hash every output file; print the SHA-256 of SHA256SUMS
( cd -- "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print | sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum ) > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"
# ---- frozen patterns (B.2); HY = ASCII hyphen or one of 11 Unicode hyphen/dash code points, as UTF-8 bytes ----
# ---- S0 environment (no paths, no names) and preflight validity ----
# ---- S3 primary passes over the whole captured history (no lower bound, no date filter) ----
if (s ~ pat) print h "\t" st "\t" p > fp; else if (s ~ var) print h "\t" st "\t" p > fv }' \
# ---- S4 ref names, and commits exclusive to PAT-named refs ----
if (s ~ pat) print "PAT\t" t "\t" $5; else if (s ~ var) print "VAR\t" t "\t" $5}' "$OUT/01_refs.tsv" > "$OUT/15_refname_hits.tsv"; ok refscan $? 0
while IFS="$TAB" read -r kind tip rn <&3; do
# ---- S5 hit set (R0-3: every primary source feeds it) ----
# ---- S6 variant passes (reported separately; never counted) ----
# ---- S7 anchors: when text naming R-72 / R-87 / R-89 was recorded (never decision or force) ----
if (s ~ pat) print h "\tA\t" np "\t" (iscomment(t) ? "COMMENT" : "CODE") "\t" t
/^-/ { t = substr($0, 2); if ((" " t " ") ~ pat) print h "\tR\t" (op != "" ? op : np) "\t-\t" t; next }
g log -1 --format=%s "$h" < /dev/null > "$T"; ok "subj.$h" $? 0; awk -v h="$h" '{print h "\tS\t" $0}' "$T" >> "$OUT/92_msg.tsv"
g log -1 --format='%(trailers:only,unfold,valueonly)' "$h" < /dev/null > "$T"; ok "trl.$h" $? 0; awk -v h="$h" 'NF{print h "\tT\t" $0}' "$T" >> "$OUT/92_msg.tsv"
g log -1 --format=%b "$h" < /dev/null > "$T"; ok "body.$h" $? 0; awk -v h="$h" '{print h "\tB\t" $0}' "$T" >> "$OUT/92_msg.tsv"
while (match(s, wpany)) { t = substr(s, RSTART, RLENGTH); if (first == "") first = t; if (t !~ wpc) other = 1; s = substr(s, RSTART + RLENGTH) }
h = ord[i]; wpscan(subj[h]); fnt = (first != "" && first !~ wpc)
print h "\t" c "\t" z "\t" f "\t" np[h] "\t" k "\t" at[h] "\t" ct[h]
-v f94="$OUT/94_lines.tsv" -v f16="$OUT/16_ref_exclusive.tsv" -v pat="$PATX" -v r89="$R89X" -v wpany="$WPANY" -v wpc="$WPC" \
# ---- S10 ancestry, earliest traces, order labels, CLOCK_ANOMALY (B.4) ----
isanc() { g merge-base --is-ancestor "$1" "$2" < /dev/null; local rc=$?; ok "anc.$1.$2" "$rc" 0 1; return "$rc"; }
MINAWK='BEGIN{FS="\t"; while ((getline l < only) > 0) e[l]=1; while ((getline l < anc) > 0) {split(l, p, "\t"); if ((p[1] in e) && (p[2] in e)) d[p[2]]=1}} ($1 in e) && !($1 in d)'
if [ -s "$OUT/98c.tmp" ]; then g log --stdin --no-walk=unsorted --format='%H%x09%at%x09%ct' < "$OUT/98c.tmp" > "$OUT/98c_dates.tsv"; ok dates $? 0; fi
if isanc "$e" "$x"; then r=E_BEFORE_X; elif isanc "$x" "$e"; then r=X_BEFORE_E; else r=NONE; fi
function chk(a, d) { if ((a in ct) && (d in ct) && ct[d] + 0 < ct[a] + 0) { bad[a] = 1; bad[d] = 1; print a "\t" d > fanom } }
while ((getline l < fd) > 0) { split(l, p, "\t"); at[p[1]] = p[2]; ct[p[1]] = p[3] }
while ((getline l < fa) > 0) { split(l, p, "\t"); chk(p[1], p[2]) }
while ((getline l < fr) > 0) { split(l, p, "\t"); if (p[3] == "E_BEFORE_X") chk(p[1], p[2]); else if (p[3] == "X_BEFORE_E") chk(p[2], p[1]) }
while ((getline l < fr) > 0) { split(l, p, "\t"); e = p[1]; x = p[2]
else if (bad[e] || bad[x] || !(e in ct) || !(x in ct)) lab = "NOT_IDENTIFIABLE\t-"
else { sa = sgn(at[e] - at[x]); sc = sgn(ct[e] - ct[x])
awk -v e="$e" '{if ($0 ~ /^refs\/heads\//) h++; else if ($0 ~ /^refs\/remotes\//) r++; else if ($0 ~ /^refs\/tags\//) t++; else o++}
END{printf "%s\theads=%d\tremotes=%d\ttags=%d\tother=%d\n", e, h, r, t, o}' "$OUT/.c" >> "$OUT/99a_refclass.tsv"

residual_risks: Untokened work on non-PAT-named or merged refs is invisible (identifier-based search).
Hyphen-like code points outside HY are not matched.
Quoted paths (with control characters) may be mis-parsed; a path literally named '::commit::' would confuse the path pass.
Identity overlap uses emails (ACTOR_SET_ID) and is indicative only.
The EXEC writer set is approximated by path exclusion; either kind of overlap disqualifies a channel as NIF-A, so misassigning a writer between EXEC and REG does not change Q5.
